All the registered students for poster presentation should prepare their own poster before presentation.
The students should prepare their own poster on their own topics.
The organizers will invite two judges they will judge the best poster among all the posters.
The best poster is awarded with a certification

## Venue:

D-311, D Block, MGIT

## Event Guidelines:

- Select any topic strictly from technical topics.
- Each team will consist of maximum 3-4 participants.
- Only one poster/paper will be allowed to present per team.
- The official language for the poster will be English.
- All participants will receive participation certificates.
